verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's Marketing and Transactional APIs are well-documented and support fully programmatic access (contacts, campaigns, sends, webhooks, account exports), enabling scripted/automated workflows outside the UI, which is the core of headless/CI usage. However there is no explicit CI/CD tooling (official SDKs for automation pipelines, CLI, GitHub Actions) or rate-limit/quota guidance for high-volume automated use, and community reports note the UI-side automation can be blocked by anti-bot heuristics (dev tools triggering IP bans), which raises some doubt about robustness for automated tooling even if API access itself isn't shown to be blocked. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/CD examples or SDKs, explicit automation rate-limit docs, and independent confirmation that API-based automation is unaffected by the anti-bot blocking seen in UI contexts.
